dedupe_keys.name: direct simple shear testing on ottawa f65 sand under uniform and irregular cyclic loading

description: Direct simple shear testing on Ottawa F65 sand under uniform and irregular cyclic loading is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Katerina Ziotopoulou, University of California Davis (ucdavis.edu). This project summarizes the results of undrained cyclic direct simple shear (DSS) tests performed on specimens of Ottawa F65 sand. Constant-volume (equivalent undrained) uniform and non-uniform cyclic direct simple shear (DSS) experiments were conducted using an Electromechanical Dynamic Cyclic Simple Shear (EMDCSS) device manufactured by GDS Instruments. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: DSS, Cyclic, Direct Simple Shear, Liquefaction, Ottawa. Published 2025-10-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
